title.narrative: Guttmacher and other partners: safe abortion

description.narrative: Agreement with the Guttmacher institute to provide timely, actionable evidence that can be used to improve policies and programs and increase access to safe abortion (Impact). Through this program, Guttmacher and partners will deliver abortion research that meets the needs of policymakers, advocates and health care providers, while leveraging the evidence to catalyze policy and program change to increase access to safe, comprehensive abortion care in low- and middle-income countries. Improving access to safe abortion and SRHR will contribute to gender equality. The project will be implemented in Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Uganda, Kenya, Pakistan, Colombia, Mozambique, Malawi and Nepal. Some of the studies will be collecting data on people’s disability status and barriers to getting their SRH needs met. Implementing partners for this project that will be receiving funds through the Norad grant are: • WHO’s Programme of Research, Development and Research Training in Human Reproduction (HRP) and the following country level institutions: • Bangladesh Association for Prevention of Septic Abortion (BAPSA) and Brac University James P Grant School of Public Health (BRAC JPGSPH), Bangladesh • African Population and Health Research Center (APHRC), Kenya • Brujula Comunicaciones, Colombia • Population Council–Pakistan • Chama Cha Uzazi na Malezi Bora Tanzania (UMATI), Tanzania • Center for Research on Environment Health and Population Activities (CREHPA), Nepal
